title: Find your way around the web
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

These are sites you have not visited in the lessons. You will need to type addresses yourself.

playgroundTask.goal: You navigated the web on your own
playgroundTask.hint: The strip at the top of the browser is where addresses go. The small icon to the left of the address tells you whether a site is safe. Pop-ups always have a way to dismiss them that is not the big button.

steps.say: Look up citylibrary.example and read when the library opens.
Save that page so you can come back to it later.
Check whether the page you are on is a secure connection.
Go to weather.com and turn down its optional cookies.
Go to freegames.example and get rid of the pop-up without clicking anything inside it.

drDigitalSuccess: You found a site, saved it, checked it was secure, refused tracking, and shut down a scam pop-up — without a single instruction telling you where to click.
drDigitalHint: To visit a site, click the wide bar at the top, type the address, and press Enter. The padlock beside the address tells you about security. A pop-up's small ✕ closes it; its big button does not.
warning: One of these sites throws a pop-up with a big CLEAN NOW button. Do not click it — that is the trap.
